## Pull request title and commits

Use the format `<type>(<optional scope>): <emoji> <subject>` for the PR title and each commit.
The Conventional Commit type must come first; use a Unicode emoji (not a shortcode) immediately
at the start of the subject.

| Type | Emoji |
| --- | --- |
| `feat` | ✨ |
| `fix` | 🐛 |
| `perf` | ⚡ |
| Security fix (`fix`) | 🔒 |
| `refactor` | ♻️ |
| `docs` | 📝 |
| `ci` | 👷 |
| `build` | 📦 |
| `chore` | 🔧 |
| `style` | 💄 |
| `test` | ✅ |
| `revert` | ⏪ |
| Breaking feature (`feat!`) | 💥 |

Example: `feat: ✨ add version endpoint`.
